project_type: TanStack Start (SSR + server functions) + React 19 + Vite 8 SPA — a WebGPU/WebGL2 particle simulator (Helion) deployed on Vercel via the Nitro vercel preset. Live in production at built-helion.vercel.app.
build_system: npm. `npm run build` = `node scripts/with-app-env.mjs vite build && npm run db:migrate && node scripts/sync-dist.mjs`. Build uses VITE (esbuild/rollup), NOT tsc, so it passes despite pre-existing tsc errors. `npm run dev` serves 0.0.0.0:3000 (note: auth code references an :8080 local-dev contract in trustedOrigins/LOCAL_DEV_ORIGINS; dev actually serves :3000 — trustedOrigins must cover the dev origin actually used).
test_framework: node:test. `npm test` runs (a) `node --test 'scripts/**/*.test.mjs'` and (b) `node --experimental-strip-types --test` over src/lib/app-data/app-data.test.ts, src/lib/auth/gate-identity.test.ts, src/lib/feedback/feedback.test.ts. Src DB tests use a custom loader hook (src/lib/feedback/pglite-glob-loader.mjs) that resolves the @/ alias and inlines real migration SQL so tests hit a REAL PGLite database (no mocks, no seeds). New src test files must be added to the `test` script's explicit file list in package.json to run in CI.
verification_instructions: 1) `npm test` — separate the 16 pre-existing environmental failures in scripts/**/*.test.mjs (missing .grok/skills dirs) from any new failures; all 46 src-level tests currently pass. 2) `npm run build` must exit 0. 3) `npm run dev` (serves http://localhost:3000) and exercise REAL flows against local PGLite: sign up email+password, sign out, sign back in; use sim + submit feedback while LOGGED OUT including a BLANK email (must succeed); public board shows the item WITHOUT email and upvote increments + persists; settings auto-fill-email toggle defaults OFF and only pre-fills when ON + logged in. No mock/seed rows anywhere.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by @tanstack/router-plugin from files in src/routes/ during vite build/dev — do NOT hand-edit; add routes as files and let the plugin regenerate. .vercel/output and dist/ are build artifacts.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Node v22 default, npm, bun 1.2.14 available. No env vars required locally: app falls back to embedded PGLite when DATABASE_URL unset. `npm run dev` -> http://localhost:3000.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET. No Docker used (Vercel/Nitro app; verify via npm build + dev). Local runs use embedded PGLite (in-memory, resets on restart) — the SAME code path serves Neon in prod when DATABASE_URL is set. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator does that).
contribution_requirements: HARD: no mock/seeded data anywhere — every list/board/admin view reads real Postgres rows; empty states reflect genuinely empty queries. Never gate the sim or feedback behind auth (logged-out is first-class). Never expose user_email or any PII on the public feedback board or any unauthenticated server-function response. Keep the server-only boundary: getSql() and *.server.ts modules must never enter the client bundle — client-safe modules (types.ts) stay import-free of server code, and server functions dynamically import server-only modules inside their handlers. Do NOT invent OAuth credentials.
key_patterns: DB: src/lib/db.ts getSql() (tagged-template + .query()), server-only (throws in browser); Neon when DATABASE_URL set else embedded PGLite; getPglite() exposes the shared PGLite instance for Better Auth's Kysely dialect. Migrations: migrations/*.sql applied automatically on both backends (non-recursive glob) and at build via scripts/migrate.mjs; keyed by BASENAME in _migrations. INVARIANT (scripts/migration-plan.test.mjs): the Better Auth schema lives at migrations/auth/0001_auth.sql (OUT of the top-level glob); if you copy it to migrations/0001_auth.sql to turn sign-in on, the copy MUST be byte-identical to the source (test enforces). Server functions: createServerFn({method}).validator(zodSchema.parse).handler(async ({data}) => { const { fn } = await import('./x.server.ts'); ... }). Auth client: src/lib/auth/client.ts (authClient = createAuthClient), use-current-user.ts (useCurrentUserState -> {user, isPending}), gates.tsx (SignedIn/SignedOut/UserButton). Forms: react-hook-form + zodResolver (see feedback-dialog.tsx). Toasts: sonner (Toaster mounted in __root.tsx). Store: zustand src/store/lab-store.ts. UI primitives: src/components/ui/ (Button etc), Radix.
